resources.version: Benchmark revision specified by the experiment manifest
resources.how_to_get: Obtain the selected benchmark revision, set options.html_root, and bind its files in required_files.

resources.version: Qwen3.5-9B; exact snapshot must come from the experiment manifest
resources.how_to_get: Supply the selected model snapshot and resource-manifest.json mapping its files to SHA-256. Record the model revision and a distinct experiment identity for each new snapshot.

Place the original PROJECT_ASSETS.json contents at the data/runtime-audit.json resource. Environment dependency and pinned model provenance are recorded separately in data/environment-provenance.json; recreate current environments from uv.lock.

resources.version: Revision specified by the WebArena study protocol
resources.license: BrowserGym Apache-2.0; datasets/images have their own licenses
resources.how_to_get: Use the container image digest and environment credentials recorded for the selected WebArena study. Configure that environment before invoking its adapter.
